description: Figma REST -> staging-only Unity UGUI prefabs. Node orchestrates export/contract/install/build; the embedded Unity Editor package (source manifest + approximation overlay -> IR -> Prefab) is the only source->IR converter.

environment.name: FIGMA_ACCESS_TOKEN
environment.description: Primary Figma token source (file_content:read). Never stored in tracked repo files; always redacted in logs. Falls back to the per-project figmaAccessToken in the user config (~/.config/figma-to-uprefab/config.json).

environment.name: ProgramFiles / LOCALAPPDATA
environment.description: Used to discover the Unity Editor via Unity Hub (Editor/<version>/Editor/Unity.exe) when unity.editorPath is not set.

agent.whenToUse: Use to convert tagged Figma frames into staging-only Unity UGUI prefabs: export source manifests + node PNGs, validate the staging contract, install the embedded Unity converter package, or run the C# converter in Unity batch. Never use for promoting generated assets into runtime paths or writing UIConfig.

commands.description: Add the project's section to the user config (~/.config/figma-to-uprefab/config.json). Does not modify the project.

output.description: User config path + project key of the created/existing section.

safety: writes only the user config file; never touches Unity assets

commands.description: Add a project section (defaults, uiSystem UGUI, no token field) to the user config.
safety: writes only the user config file

commands.description: Validate the user config project section against the user-config schema, token presence (env > config), and uiSystem (NGUI fails closed).

output.description: Config validity + issue list (legacy files, schema, missing section, missing token, NGUI).

safety: read-only
never prints a token

commands.description: Fold legacy figma-to-uprefab.json + figma-to-uprefab.local.json into the user config and rename them to *.migrated. Never copies a token.

output.description: Project key migrated + list of renamed legacy files.

exitCodes.1: error (nothing to migrate, existing section without --force, invalid merge)

safety: writes only the user config file; renames legacy files in place
never copies figmaAccessToken out of legacy files

commands.description: Figma REST -> source manifests + node-scoped PNGs + root index under staging. No Unity side effects.

options.description: test hook: read node documents from <safe-id>.json files
discover roots without fetching node docs or images

output.description: Discovered root count + staging root index path.

exitCodes.1: error (token missing, REST failure, discovery violation)

safety: writes only under the configured _Staging root
token never logged, never written into manifests
timeout + bounded 429/5xx retry; atomic file publish; path-traversal rejection

commands.description: Validate the canonical staging layout against schemas + path invariants. Read-only.

options.description: report missing IR as warning instead of error

safety: read-only; no Unity side effects

commands.description: Read-only diagnostics of config, staging, Unity install, editor, and token presence.

output.description: Per-check [ok]/[FAIL] lines with token presence (masked only).

safety: read-only
masks the token; never prints it

commands.description: Print or export the canonical AGENTS.md agent spec. Does not install skills.

options.description: write docs to a file instead of stdout

safety: no skills installed; documentation only

commands.description: Install the embedded com.kevlns.figma-to-uprefab UPM package into the project. Explicit, dry-run, hash receipt, modification detection, atomic with rollback.

output.description: Status, package dir, file count, receipt path.

safety: writes only <project>/Packages/com.kevlns.figma-to-uprefab + Library/figma-to-uprefab receipt
receipt records exact tree hashes; modification fails closed
staged temp + rename; previous install backed up and restored on failure

commands.description: Report whether the embedded package is installed and whether it was modified since its receipt.
safety: read-only

commands.description: Remove the embedded package. Refuses (fail-closed) if the installed tree was modified unless --force.
safety: fail-closed on modified install without --force

commands.description: Run the C# converter in Unity batch mode (request/report protocol). Fails closed when the package is not installed, the receipt is missing, or Unity is running.

options.description: proceed even if Unity is running

output.description: Build report: per-root errorCode/errorMessage, conversion, build summary. Report path printed.

exitCodes.1: error (missing install/receipt, Unity running, or any root failed)

safety: writes only Library/figma-to-uprefab/request.json + report.json and staging outputs
never fabricates a compile result; outcome comes from Unity exit code + report JSON
